name: github_actions_job_errors
title: GitHub Actions job errors
description: A workflow run's job logs contain an ##[error] line, so at least one step failed. Steps with continue-on-error also log ##[error]. Failed runs are sent only when the workflow's sender job runs with if: always().

query_condition.sql: SELECT run_id, count(DISTINCT job_id) AS failed_jobs, max(split_part(split_part(log, '##[error]', 2), chr(10), 1)) AS error_message FROM "githubactions" WHERE log LIKE '%##[error]%' GROUP BY run_id
